prose: Crrow777 is a regular guy who's spent a lot of time behind a telescope, shooting the moon and other aerial objects. In this episode we talk about some of the discoveries he's made and filmed, we point out some of the obvious lies from NASA, internet censorship and free speech, and plenty more.
ext: We get into Spagyrics and Alchemy, problems with the western medical model, why scientific materialism is letting us down, and the great conjunction at the end of 2020, according to the Sky Clock (astro-logos).
